steps.title: Collect Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Collect 2 mL of the UTEX 250-A cell culture in a tube.

steps.title: Harvest and Store Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 4000 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature. Carefully discard the supernatant. The resulting cell pellet can be stored at -80 °C.

steps.title: Optional Biomass Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform these optional steps if dry-weight biomass is required.

substeps.instruction: Pre-weigh empty 2 mL threaded tubes with an accuracy of at least 0.1 mg.
Lyophilize the cell pellet overnight.
Measure the tube again to obtain the dry biomass (mg).

steps.title: Homogenize Cells
steps.instruction: Grind the cells using a TissueLyser II (or equivalent homogenizer) at 30 Hz for 1 minute, twice (total 2 minutes).

substeps.instruction: If using liquid nitrogen, flash-freeze pellets before each grinding interval.
For non-lyophilized frozen pellets, keep pellets flash-frozen using liquid nitrogen before placing tubes in a cold TissueLyser II adapter pre-chilled at -20 °C (do not freeze at -80 °C).
Chill tubes with liquid nitrogen between grinding intervals.
Visually inspect for sufficient homogenization; repeat if cell chunks are observed.

steps.title: Prepare Lipid Extraction Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a fresh lipid extraction solution by mixing dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol in a 2:1 (v/v) ratio (e.g., 1 mL DCM to 0.5 mL Methanol for 1 reaction, or 12 mL DCM to 6 mL Methanol for 12 reactions).

substeps.instruction: Store the solution in a temporary amber glass bottle with a PTFE-lined cap.

steps.title: Extract Lipids
steps.instruction: Perform lipid extraction using beads and solvent.

substeps.instruction: Add beads to each tube: either Option 1 (two 4 mm glass beads and 200 mg of 0.5 mm glass beads) or Option 2 (250 mg of 2 mm zirconia beads, approx. 12 beads).
Distribute beads and cell pellet by vortexing and/or tapping the tube.
Add 1.5 mL of the lipid extraction solution, cap, and vortex for 3 seconds.
Centrifuge at 4000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant (crude extract) to a new 2 mL safe-lock tube, avoiding the transfer of cell debris and beads.

steps.title: Isolate Lipid Phase
steps.instruction: Separate the organic lipid phase from the extract.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the crude extract at 3000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Carefully transfer the bottom lipid phase using a pipette or glass pasteur pipette to a 2 mL clear screw top vial.
Visually inspect the vial and remove any transferred beads or upper layer blobs.
Store at -20 °C in the dark. Allow the vial to equilibrate to room temperature before opening to avoid condensation.

steps.title: Optional Re-extraction for Maximum Yield
steps.instruction: Perform a 2-step re-extraction on the pellet from the initial extraction if the pellet is visibly yellow.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of milliQ water to the pellet and vortex to resuspend.
Spin at 3000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the extraction steps (bead addition, solvent addition, and centrifugation).
Combine the resulting organic layer with the previous lipid phase.

steps.title: Quantify Total Lipid Weight
steps.instruction: Determine the net weight of the extracted lipids.

substeps.instruction: Pre-weigh an empty 2 mL screw-top clear vial (Agilent 5182-0715).
Completely dry the lipid solution using UHP Nitrogen gas.
Weigh the vial to determine the net lipid weight.

steps.title: Prepare Lipid Sample for Analysis
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried lipids in dichloromethane (DCM) to a final concentration of 20 mg/mL (e.g., using 1 mL DCM or adjusting based on lipid weight).

steps.title: Perform Acid-Catalyzed Methanolysis
steps.instruction: Convert lipids to fatty acid methyl esters (FAME).

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL - 1 mL of lipids to a 16x150 mm threaded glass tube.
Mix with 5 µL of C13:0 fatty acid (5 mg/mL in DCM) as an internal standard.
Add 1 mL of 1 N Methanolic hydrogen chloride (HCl-MeOH).
Seal the tube with a new PTFE septum inside the cap.
Incubate in a waterbath at 80 °C for 30 minutes, checking for leaks every 10 minutes.
If leaks occur, cool the tube to room temperature, add more 1N HCl-MeOH, and replace the cap/septum.

steps.title: Purify FAME for GC Analysis
steps.instruction: Isolate the FAME layer for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Wait for the tube to return to room temperature.
Add 1 mL of 0.9% (w/v) Sodium Chloride and 1 mL of n-hexane, then vortex briefly.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Transfer the top layer to a 2 mL amber screw top vial, avoiding the bottom layer.
Immediately mix the crude extract with 325 µL of 0.88% (w/v) potassium chloride in water.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes and transfer the top layer to a 2 mL amber screw top vial.
Dry the FAME solution using an evaporator with nitrogen.
Resuspend with 500 µL - 1 mL of n-hexane or heptane and store at -20 °C.
Transfer 50 µL of FAME to a 300 μL amber vial with insert for GC-MS or GC-FID analysis (dilute with hexane if necessary).

steps.title: Lipase Digestion of Total Lipids
steps.instruction: Digest total lipids using porcine pancreas lipase to isolate sn-2 positions.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 4-5 mg of total lipids in DCM (e.g., 250 µL of 20 mg/mL extract) to a 16x150 mm threaded glass tube and dry with UHP Nitrogen gas.
Prepare lipase solution (using 0.1% bile acid/taurocholic acid solution).
Add 20 µL of DCM to dissolve the lipid, then add 1.35 mL of lipase solution, cap, and vortex for 1-2 seconds.
Incubate the mixture at 40 °C for 1 minute.
Vortex at full speed for 3 seconds, return to 40 °C water bath for 10-20 seconds; repeat this cycle for 2 minutes (process max 12 tubes per batch, vortexing 3-4 at a time).
Incubate at 40 °C for an additional 10 minutes.
Add 1 mL of DCM, vortex for 2-5 seconds, and centrifuge at 3000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Carefully transfer the bottom layer to a 2 mL clear screw top vial and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: TLC Separation of Neutral Lipids
steps.instruction: Separate digested lipids using Thin Layer Chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Bake 20x20cm TLC Silica plates at 85 °C - 120 °C for 30 minutes.
Prepare a TLC developing tank with neutral lipid separation solvent, a saturation pad, and a lid; let sit for 30 minutes.
Draw a line 2 cm from the bottom of the plate and mark 9 points at 2 cm intervals.
Condense the digested lipid solution with UHP Nitrogen gas to 20 µL - 40 µL.
Load lipid samples onto the marked points (optionally load 5 µL of TAG/DAG/MAG mix [10 mg/mL in DCM] as a control).
Place the plate in the chamber, close the lid, and allow separation to proceed for 40 minutes.
Remove the plate and let it sit for 5 minutes or until the solvent evaporates.
Spray the plate evenly with 0.5 mg/mL primuline (prepared as 0.05% w/v primuline in 80% acetone).
Once dry, visualize under a UV lamp (340-365 nm) in a dark chamber and circle the 2-MAG spot.
Score the outline of the 2-MAG spot with a razor blade and scrape the silica powder using a metal micro spatula.
Transfer the powder into a 16x150 mm threaded glass tube.
Add 1 mL of 1 N HCl-MeOH and 5 µL of C13:0 fatty acid (5 mg/mL in DCM) and proceed with acid-catalyzed methanolysis as described previously for GC-MS/GC-FID analysis.
